page.overview:
Who is Kazu Mori?

As representative of the Fire Lord, Kazu Mori visited Karr Lok Island and its Sunray Academy. To honor his visit, the academy decided to bring forward a scheduled regional bending tournament by a week.

When the day of the tournament arrived, Mori was granted a role of honor. Alongside Headmaster Shion and a teacher, Chuan, he presided over the event from a special booth. Shion introduced him to the audience and teams, whereupon the advisor thanked her for the hospitality and honors afforded to him. He proceeded to announce the first round's team matchups and hit a giant gong to mark the tournament's beginning.

At the supposed start of the tournament's second semifinal match, Mori was surprised to hear that one team had gotten food poisoning and dropped out of the event. He thus observed the final match of Team Adaki against Team Undefeated. When Team Adaki ultimately triumphed, Mori clapped and smiled as the young benders celebrated their victory.
